title: Compound Novelty Scorer
description: Score GENERATED molecules for patent/FTO novelty by FPSim2 Tanimoto/Morgan nearest-neighbour search against a prebuilt ChEMBL known-actives fingerprint index. Flags each molecule novel when its max Tanimoto to any known compound is below the cutoff. Optional off-by-default coarse patent-presence lookup.

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

query_smiles.description: Generated molecules to score. Either a comma-separated inline SMILES string or a path to a SMILES file (one SMILES per line).

fpsim2_db.description: Path to a prebuilt FPSim2 .h5 fingerprint index of known actives (e.g. ChEMBL). MOUNTED read-only (never Nextflow-staged) — identical to fpsim2_chemical_similarity. Build/host once with that subworkflow's tools/prepare_fpsim2_db.sh.

novelty_tanimoto_cutoff.description: A molecule is flagged novel when its max Tanimoto to the known-actives library is strictly below this cutoff. 0.85 is the usual 'materially distinct scaffold' threshold.

check_patents.description: OFF by default. When true, additionally query SureChEMBL/PubChem for a coarse patent-presence signal per molecule. Requires network access; the core novelty path needs no network beyond the mounted FPSim2 DB.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline.

outdir.description: The output directory where results will be saved.

fpsim2_container.description: FPSim2 biocontainer image. On Batch, mirror to ECR as needed.
